output.reason: The linked PR [ev-2955a2390de6][ev-a95dca88b623] says provider installs with a DeploymentRuntimeConfig were "currently broken on main". It reproduced the bug on a development build (v1.21.0-rc.0.163…), where duplicate volumeMount paths made the provider Deployment invalid, and fixed it with a one-file internal change [ev-c8ee24a21df6]. Nothing in the evidence says a released version had the bug, so this looks like a fix for a regression that only existed on main. The proposed exposure flags every DeploymentRuntimeConfig that sets spec.deploymentTemplate.spec, which is far broader than the evidence supports. No narrower condition about operator-visible exposure follows from the evidence either.
